newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM hints at Unilever chemicals buy.
newsitem.headline: DSM hints at Unilever chemicals buy.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM on Tuesday expressed interest in the specialty chemicals units recently put up for sale by Unilever.
"We are very interested in seeing what this unexpected gesture by Unilever could mean for us," DSM chairman Simon de Bree told a news conference on the firm's 1996 results.
Unilever announced earlier this month it was putting up four of its specialty chemicals units for sale -- National Starch and Chemical, Quest International, Unichema International and Crosfield.
"There are four parts, of which two would fit better (with DSM's activities)," De Bree told the news conference.
Asked whether this included Quest, he replied he did not think so.
But De Bree declined to comment further beyond saying "We are not officially bidding yet."
While best-known as a producer of bulk petrochemicals and plastics, DSM is gradually building up a presence in less cyclical sectors such as fine chemicals.
